visual_qa: Both PNGs visually inspected. Original nonhumanoid sac, three legs, one slotted key and cel palette retained. Independently generated concept views may have minor projection/interface differences; they are not renders of a single verified 3D mesh. No physical gear/rig simulation or mesh validation performed.
